result.topic_en: Concluding section §55 on the sounds emitted by an elastic ring: the principal tone formula, the higher partials following the square numbers, the purity of tone compared with musical strings, and the inverse-square dependence on the perimeter.

items.quote: reliqui vero ſoni ſimplices ſecundum numeros quadratos 4, 9, 16, 25, progrediuntur
items.english: The remaining simple tones progress according to the square numbers 4, 9, 16, 25.

items.quote: id quod etiam in integris diſcis et catinis campaniformibus euenire debere videtur
items.english: This also seems bound to happen in whole discs and bell-shaped bowls.

items.quote: Caeterum manente eadem elaſticitate hi ſoni tenent rationem reciprocam duplicatam totius perimetri $a$
items.english: Moreover, with the same elasticity, these tones are inversely proportional to the square of the whole perimeter a.
